component.name: Google Antigravity IDE
component.summary: AI-first integrated development environment built on VS Code

description.p: Google Antigravity IDE is an AI-first integrated development environment built on VS Code. It integrates advanced agentic coding, multi-file code synthesis, context-aware completions, and terminal workflows directly into a familiar editor.
Key capabilities include autonomous coding subagents, deep project-wide indexing, seamless terminal integration, and direct support for Gemini models.
